rationale: Salesforce's three annual release cycles plus unannounced sandbox policy changes create a recurring, high-severity pain for ISV developers: integration pipelines break silently, engineering hours are consumed diagnosing platform-side changes, and the pain recurs with every release window. Multiple Stack Exchange threads, Salesforce community posts, and the existence of paid changelog/monitoring tools (Salesforce Release Monitor, Salto, etc.) confirm both the frequency and willingness to pay. At least one direct willingness-to-pay signal exists: teams are already paying for release monitoring SaaS and Salesforce consulting hours to handle this.
